posts.title: Posts
posts.trashHint: Posts in the trash are permanently deleted 30 days after deletion.

bulk.label: With selected posts
bulk.skipped_one: Skipped {{count}} post hidden by an administrator.
bulk.skipped_other: Skipped {{count}} posts hidden by an administrator.

posts.unscheduled: The schedule was cancelled. The post is a draft again.
posts.hiddenHint: An administrator hid this post. Its publish settings and visibility cannot be changed.

settings.title: Blog settings
settings.commentHint: When off, no new comments can be added to any post on this blog.
settings.portalEnabled: Show this blog's posts on the portal
settings.portalHint: When off, this blog's posts don't appear on the portal home or topic pages. The blog itself and its feeds are unchanged.
settings.defaultTopicHint: This topic is preselected when you write a new post. You can change it for each post.
settings.guestbookHint: When off, the guestbook disappears from the blog menu and visitors cannot see it. Existing entries are kept.
settings.guestWriteEnabled: Allow comments and guestbook entries from guests
settings.guestWriteHint: When on, visitors who are not logged in can write comments and guestbook entries with a name and password. They can edit or delete them only with the same password.

feed.title: Feed settings
feed.contentHint: With Summary, the feed carries only post summaries and readers open the blog for the full text.
feed.categoryHint: Each category has an RSS feed at addresses like these (a parent category includes its subcategories).

guestbook.title: Manage guestbook
guestbook.disabled: The guestbook is turned off, so visitors cannot see it.
guestbook.settingsLink: Turn it on in blog settings

design.title: Design
design.sidebarHint: Checked items appear in the blog sidebar in this order from the top. Moving up or down is saved right away.
design.noticesHint: Set notices with "Pin as notice" in the publish settings or with bulk actions in post management.
design.noNotices: No posts are pinned as notices.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.timeZoneNote: Dates follow the service time zone (Korea time), not your time zone. Each visitor is counted once a day.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Packs your blog's posts (Markdown), drafts, categories and the images used in posts into one zip file. Comments, guestbook entries and protected post passwords are not included.
backup.limit: You can create one backup per blog per day. Each file can be downloaded for 7 days.
backup.requested: Backup requested. We'll notify you when it's ready.
backup.failed: The backup could not be created. Please request it again.
backup.working: Creating the backup. This page refreshes every 30 seconds.

blocks.title: Blocked members
blocks.description: Blocked members can't comment, write in the guestbook or subscribe to this blog. What they already wrote stays.
blocks.confirm: Block {{nickname}}? They won't be able to comment, write in the guestbook or subscribe to this blog, and their subscription will be removed.
